shortfall_bcf.label: sourced
shortfall_bcf.source: Enstar's president to legislators ("18 days" of supply this winter), ADN 2026

storage_aug_bcf.label: sourced
storage_aug_bcf.source: ADN editorial on Southcentral gas, Aug 2026 (storage level in August)

deliverability_loss_mmcfd.label: sourced
deliverability_loss_mmcfd.source: Legislative testimony 2024: storage-well failure cut deliverability from 150 to 121.5 MMcf/day

needle_peak_mmcfd.label: sourced
needle_peak_mmcfd.source: Petroleum News, 2021: Enstar needle-peak supply contract

needle_peak_days.label: sourced
needle_peak_days.source: Petroleum News, 2021: needle-peak supply available up to 25 days per winter

avg_home_mcf_year.label: sourced
avg_home_mcf_year.source: Enstar via ADN, 2012: average residential use

lng_earliest.label: sourced
lng_earliest.source: Kenai mayor via Homer News, 2026: LNG imports late 2029 at the earliest

socal_event_pct.label: sourced
socal_event_pct.source: SoCalGas smart-thermostat DR evaluation, winter 2018–19: reduction during morning event hours

socal_daily_pct.label: sourced
socal_daily_pct.source: SoCalGas smart-thermostat DR evaluation, winter 2018–19: net daily reduction

coned_snapback_pct.label: sourced
coned_snapback_pct.source: ConEd gas DR smart-thermostat pilot evaluation: share of calculated savings lost to snapback

winter_optout_pct.label: sourced
winter_optout_pct.source: Cooperative smart-thermostat pilot: participants opted out of 6% of winter events

socal_cost_usd_therm.label: sourced
socal_cost_usd_therm.source: SoCalGas estimate: pilot cost per therm shifted or shed

energy_watch_2012_pct.label: sourced
energy_watch_2012_pct.source: ADN, 2012: Energy Watch 2-hour drill, ~1.5% regional energy load reduction

hhv_btu_per_cf.label: assumed
hhv_btu_per_cf.source: Typical pipeline gas; replace with Enstar's published value if found

space_heat_share.label: assumed
space_heat_share.source: Share of residential gas used for space heating (master plan §9)

hdd_annual.label: derived
hdd_annual.source: Mean annual HDD 1996–2025, ANCHORAGE TED STEVENS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (PANC), ACIS StnData; see data/calibration.json

ua_mean_btuh_per_f.label: derived
ua_mean_btuh_per_f.source: space_heat_share × avg_home_mcf_year × 1,000 × hhv_btu_per_cf × eta_furnace ÷ (24 × hdd_annual) = 0.75 × 149,000 × 1,030 × 0.85 ÷ (24 × 9818.5); see data/calibration.json

floor_min_f.label: assumed
floor_min_f.source: Design choice: hard minimum comfort floor

max_depth_default_f.label: assumed
max_depth_default_f.source: Design choice: default maximum setback depth

exempt_share.label: assumed
exempt_share.source: Share of enrolled homes exempt (infant, elderly, medical) (master plan §9)

tier2_effectiveness.label: assumed
tier2_effectiveness.source: Effectiveness of a Tier 2 pledged (manual) setback relative to automated Tier 1

override_rate.label: assumed
override_rate.source: Set equal to winter_optout_pct from the cooperative pilot; applying it to Anchorage is an assumption

validation_socal_daily_band.label: assumed
validation_socal_daily_band.source: Design choice: band around the published 2.2% (master plan §9)
